title: Petra and the Language
author: Cyrus Yarrow
blurb: Xanthe Delacroix, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
